summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on experience building real-time robotics software in C++. Built a distributed, sensor-fused pick-and-place robot combining TensorRT-optimized computer vision and perception pipelines on Jetson and Arduino hardware, and validated ROS 2 kinematics and motion planning on physical robotic arms (UR5e, AL5B) using MoveIt and RViz. Additional background in CUDA-level performance optimization of C++ inference kernels and embedded sensor integration.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.

Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.
Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.
Achieved 1.5–2× speedup in convolution operations through efficient global memory utilization.

Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights/biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.
